title: Customize lsblk output columns
summary: Add specific information columns like serial number, model, or rotation status to the lsblk output.

steps.explain: Use the output flag with a plus sign to add extra columns to the default lsblk output. Replace <COLUMNS> with a comma-separated list of column names.

placeholders.name: COLUMNS
placeholders.description: Comma-separated list of column names to add (e.g., NAME,ROTA,SERIAL,MODEL,TRAN,TYPE,SIZE,FSTYPE,MOUNTPOINT).

steps.expect: The output includes the default columns plus the requested extra columns.

alternatives.explain: Omit the plus sign to display ONLY the specified columns, hiding the default ones.

placeholders.name: COLUMNS
placeholders.description: Comma-separated list of column names to display exclusively.
